## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are **signed off** (`git commit -s`) and follow
      [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass locally.
- [ ] Tests added/updated (a bug fix includes a regression test; new behavior
      includes unit + property tests where applicable).
- [ ] I did **not** weaken any `negative`/`kat` (release-blocking) test.
- [ ] Public API changes have docstrings and reference docs.
- [ ] No security-sensitive details in this PR — those go through
      [private reporting](https://github.com/rosualinpetru/addlib/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
